text_block_list.text:
—One of the academy's events,
the dance party known as
'Ligne Droite.'

Requested by President Symboli Rudolf,
Air Shakur produced an original track.
The event itself was a massive success, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Finally done.
Now I'm off the hook.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Shut up. Things have been rough on my end since then too.
Every last one of 'em keeps sayin' the exact same thing...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Shakur, are you not going to dance?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The DJ was amazing, and the music was wonderful!
Since we're here, why not just let loose and dance?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, the light of chaos descends from the heavens...
Dance! Even those who play hymns of praise,
let yourselves revel and drown in the feast!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I have no clue what that means...
So basically, you're saying you want to dance with us too, Shakur-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What a drag. Making me DJ on top of everything... I'm already dead tired, I tell ya.
choice_data_list: You should have danced at least a little!

text_block_list.text:
The track Air Shakur made was truly amazing;
just listening to it made my body move on its own.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I don't even have the energy to talk back anymore.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you the one who wants to dance?
Trainers usually don't participate, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that reminds me. While making the song for Droite,
I ended up writing one more track, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just a way to unwind.
Got no plans to show it to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Tch, what a pain.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...7 cm, 0 and 1, the things that fill the space in between.

Following along as told,
Air Shakur opens up her PC.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It ain't logical, but that was just part of it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's just a throwaway track
that nobody even asked for.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Here ya go.

"Staring at the outstretched hand for a moment,
I quickly understood the intention and hurried to take it."

I didn't even know how to dance.
I moved my body awkwardly to a song I was hearing for the first time.

Even while spitting out "you suck,"
Air Shakur kept dancing with me
until the end of the song.
